text:
The fetch failed. The exact error was:

```
error:100000f7:SSL routines:OPENSSL_internal:WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER
```

WebFetch upgrades `http://` URLs to HTTPS, so it likely attempted a TLS handshake with the local server. If that server speaks plain HTTP, the handshake fails with this error. The tool's description says to use curl for localhost, but I only have WebFetch and WebSearch here, so I couldn't try that. If you want the marker text, run `curl http://127.0.0.1:47613/marker.txt` in a terminal, or send it to me and I can work with it.
